corrections.proposed: 1975 burned in the Big Tujunga (Mill) Fire
corrections.why: The register says the lookout was burned in the 1975 Big Tujunga Fire, and the Angeles Adventures history says it was destroyed by that fire; 'removed' hides the cause.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1935 and a Plan BC-301 cab. Angeles Adventures says the tower moved from Mount Lukens in 1936 and lists dates 1935-1975. The story keeps 1935 as the register's figure and reports the 1936 move as the other account.
The 1960 brush fire is 15 acres on the weebly page and about 20 acres on Angeles Adventures. Both are reported.

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree the lookout burned in 1975, but disagree on the build year (1935 register vs 1936 move from Mount Lukens) and the 1960 fire size. Angeles Adventures is a local history site without a named author; it is the only source for the 1936 move and the staffing names after 1939. The 2019 detection use comes from the register's description. No Forest Service record was found. A search snippet that gave 1976 for the fire was not fetched and is not used.
